notes: No simulated array configuration is actual equipment evidence.

notes: Report each available quantity and separate total error from random and fixed bias.

notes: Supply raw heading/attitude/alignment/calibration error terms if common/diff decomposition unavailable; later reviewed mapping.

notes: HALF=(b2-b1)/2; do not confuse with total mismatch.

notes: Equivalent2x HALF requirement; not a separate independent budget.

notes: Receiver interpretation/target association must be reviewed separately.

notes: Both nodes2D independent Gaussian position estimates in model. CEP is not automatically per-axis sigma.

required_quantity: Absolute and relative position accuracy; covariance/RMS/CEP definitions
notes: Provide coordinates, reference source, systematic offsets, inter-node correlation and conversion assumptions.

required_quantity: Position update rate

required_quantity: Maintained lateral separation

required_quantity: Minimum/typical/maximum maintained separation; maneuver and speed constraints
notes: No new baseline qualification authorized; report real platform limits.

required_quantity: Known actual deployment azimuth departure magnitude
notes: Actual geometry departure from lateral90deg, not an unknown heading error. No continuous interior guarantee.

required_quantity: Actual AUX position availability and relative geometry accuracy in real time
notes: Estimator uses reported actual geometry with navigation uncertainty separately; provide accuracy and update rate.

notes: Instantaneous static model only. No motion/time-skew evidence; gather facts, do not invent threshold.
